data.title: Park chief faces visit probe
data.description: The Department of National Parks, Wildlife and Plant Conservation (DNP) has ordered an inquiry into whether the chief of Similan Islands National Park violated a departmental order by allowing a House budget committee member and his group to stay overnight in the park about four years ago.

data.title: Resort begins demolition of buildings in national park
data.description: Another tourism operator has agreed to demolish all buildings encroaching on Thap Lan National Park, Natural Resources and Environment Minister Suchart Chomklin said yesterday.

data.title: HPV Silent Threat: Experts Warn All Genders Facing Cancer Risk
data.description: Thai Red Cross urges public awareness and regular screening as human papillomavirus claims over 4,500 female lives annually in Thailand

data.title: Doctors warned about social media
data.description: The Medical Council of Thailand has warned doctors to exercise greater caution when using social media as authorities intensify a nationwide crackdown on illegal health advertising amid a surge in misleading online promotions by influencers.

data.title: SAT chief says U23s, spikers can deliver
data.description: Thailand's U23 football team will make a run into the later stages of the 20th Asian Games while the women's volleyball players will bring home a medal.

data.title: Tiger attack sparks safety review
data.description: The tragic death of a forest ranger at the jaws of a tiger has prompted grief and difficult questions. Was this an isolated incident, or a warning sign of a growing overlap between humans and Thailand's recovering tiger population? This explainer explores the latest findings, the behaviour of wild tigers and the measures being taken to prevent such a tragedy from happening again.

data.title: Myanmar targets growth in trade
data.description: Thailand and Myanmar have pledged to deepen economic cooperation, reopen key trade routes and accelerate investment as both countries seek to raise bilateral trade to US$12 billion (397 billion baht).

data.title: Senator urges dissolution of NBTC board
data.description: Senator Premsak Piayura has urged Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul to dissolve the entire National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC) board and restart the selection process.

data.title: ONE Championship: Dayakaev makes weight with ease before tense Superlek face-off
data.description: Abdulla Dayakaev and Superlek both made weight for their ONE Championship rematch on Friday – before going chest to chest in a tense final face-off in Bangkok.

data.title: Hudson targets perfect finish
data.description: Thailand head coach Anthony Hudson believes having his players rested and fully fit after a tough away game against the Philippines will be crucial as the War Elephants prepare to take on Myanmar in the final Group B match of the Asean Hyundai Cup on Saturday.

data.title: Venezuela unable to tally missing from cataclysmic quakes
data.description: CARABALLEDA (VENEZUELA) - Official figures show that over 6,000 people died in the horrific earthquakes that struck Venezuela in June, but authorities are keeping their lips sealed about how many more are missing.

data.title: UN chief denounces Russia, Ukraine for civilian deaths
data.description: KYIV (UKRAINE) - United Nations chief Antonio Guterres on Thursday condemned both sides for attacks on civilian areas as Ukraine and Russia kept up their artillery war.

data.title: UEFA says boycott of World Cups stands despite FIFA backdown on private investment
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - European football's governing body UEFA said they would maintain their boycott of the men's and women's World Cups on Thursday despite FIFA withdrawing the plan to open up their competitions to private investment.

data.title: MoUs boost Myanmar ties
data.description: Thailand and Myanmar signed three memoranda of understanding (MoUs) on Thursday aimed at deepening bilateral cooperation in labour, transboundary water quality management and space technology.

data.title: Tiger that killed ranger was juvenile, not a man-eater
data.description: The tiger that killed a wildlife ranger in Huai Kha Khaeng Wildlife Sanctuary was not fully grown, still learning to hunt and failed to meet the definition of a "man-eater", the Department of National Parks, Wildlife and Plant Conservation (DNP) said on Thursday.

data.title: UEFA chief Ceferin: 'Underdog' leader taking fight to FIFA's Infantino
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - UEFA president Aleksander Ceferin says one of his mantras is to "choose your battles", but European football's governing body is now locked in a bitter fight with FIFA boss Gianni Infantino.

data.title: Chon Buri burial site scan finds no additional bodies
data.description: CHON BURI: An extensive search of a coconut plantation in Bang Lamung district linked to the high-profile murder of two Russian siblings and a Thai family of three has turned up no additional bodies, according to police.

data.title: 'The Thai Interpreter' movie and the reality of Thai immigrants in US
data.description: Although LAAM: The Thai Interpreter (2026) takes us through the eyes of a Thai state interpreter struggling to find her footing in a career marked by injustice and suffering in the United States, it is also a rare portrayal of the bitter reality facing Thai immigrants who dream of a better life in the Land of Opportunity.

data.title: House committee member who criticised Similan park lodging faces probe
data.description: The Department of National Parks, Wildlife and Plant Conservation (DNP) has launched an investigation into whether the chief of Mu Ko Similan National Park improperly allowed an adviser to the parliamentary committee vetting the 2027 budget bill to stay overnight on the Similan Islands despite a long-standing accommodation ban, after the adviser criticised park conditions during a budget debate.

data.title: North Korea fires ballistic missile: South Korea military
data.description: SEOUL — North Korea fired a short-range ballistic missile over the Sea of Japan on Thursday, Seoul's military said, with the launch coming after Pyongyang lambasted Japan's military build-up in the Pacific.
